author: Nintendo of America
description:
Play FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE, now on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6004aLsiG
 
Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions, echoes of beloved FINAL FANTASY characters, to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.  
Begin your journey in FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE in the free demo and experience the story from the opening through the end of Chapter 1. Continue your adventure by carrying over your demo saved data to the full game.

author: Nintendo of America
description:
HYPERyuki: Snowboard Syndicate is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in early 2027!

Ride. Trick. Win. HYPERyuki: Snowboard Syndicate is a white-knuckle love letter to the extreme sports games that defined the Y2K era, and it's coming to Nintendo Switch 2!

Choose your racer from a colorful cast of boarders and carve through courses based on real-world locations. Race, catch death-defying air, string together combos, or just poke around and find what's hidden in each trick-packed locale in Chill Mode.

Unlock new boards and cosmetics to show off your style, then prove it where it counts: split-screen with friends or head-to-head online multiplayer.
